# GLOBEX FY26 Annual Report

<!-- page: 1 -->

## 1. Definitions

**Adjusted Operating Margin** means operating profit divided by revenue, adjusted to exclude impairment charges and acquisition costs. Adjusted Operating Margin is a non-GAAP measure.

**Bookings** means the total value of contracts signed during the period, whether or not revenue has been recognised.

## 2. Business Overview

GLOBEX Industries manufactures industrial sensors for utilities in Asia-Pacific. The Board approved the acquisition of Initech in Q3 (see Section 9).

<!-- page: 6 -->

## 3. Financial Results

### 3.1 Revenue

Total revenue for FY26 was USD 655 million, an increase of 11% year over year, driven by the Sensors unit and the consolidation of Initech from October. Bookings grew 14% to USD 720 million.

Table 1: Revenue by segment

| Segment | FY25 (USD m) | FY26 (USD m) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sensors | 402 | 471 | +17% |
| Services | 188 | 184 | -2% |
| Total | 590 | 655 | +11% |

<!-- page: 9 -->

### 3.2 Adjusted Operating Margin

Adjusted Operating Margin declined to 14.2% from 16.8%, despite higher revenue. The decline reflects integration costs described in Section 9 and higher input prices for rare-earth components.[^5]

Table 2: Adjusted Operating Margin reconciliation

| Item | FY25 | FY26 |
|---|---|---|
| Operating profit | 88 | 71 |
| Impairment charges | 6 | 14 |
| Acquisition costs | 5 | 8 |
| Adjusted operating profit | 99 | 93 |

<!-- page: 13 -->

## 9. Acquisition of Initech

The acquisition of Initech closed on 1 October for USD 210 million. Integration costs of USD 12 million were recognised in FY26 and are excluded from Adjusted Operating Margin per the definition in Section 1. Expected synergies are USD 25 million per year from FY28.

## 12. Notes to the Financial Statements

[^5]: FY26 Adjusted Operating Margin excludes a USD 9 million warranty provision. Had the provision been included, the margin would have been 12.8% rather than 14.2%.

Note 12 also describes the change in inventory valuation for rare-earth components adopted in FY26.
